what: Stuck stickers peel like paper from the edge nearest the press spot (Peel.js — the back side is a white shadow color). Release before it is half peeled and it sticks back in .38s cubic out, but peel past half and it comes off the document and follows the hand — position follows the hand .22 per frame, lift (scale 1.08 · shadow) .15, and tilt follows hand speed × 1.2 (±16°) at .15. On release it is thrown at hand speed × 40, falls under 1600px/s² gravity while spinning, hides off screen, and 2.5 seconds later pops back into place in .7s and sticks again. When the pointer hovers it bounces .4s, tilts the opposite way and scales to 1.08
ease: cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.64,1) hand lift · cubic out re-attach

options.back: Time until it returns after falling (ms), default 2500
options.threshold: Detached share that sticks to the hand, default .5
options.[data-fx-part=art]: Sticker graphic (SVG · text). Required — the part builds and wraps the peel-box and back

from.where: shared.js all stickers (four in the Hero · process cards · four in the footer) — original Sticker.astro: Peel corner = Edge of the pressed spot, getAmountClipped() > .5 means carried, lerp .22·.15, throw ×40, gravity 1600, returns after 2.5s

note: Peel.js (MIT, npm peel.js@1.0.1 — library/_vendor) loads the plain-script build peel.global.js first (window.Peel). The part looks up window.Peel on first press, so it may load late. While pressed it uses touch-action: none, so the page does not scroll over the sticker — use it only on small stickers.
